items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: Only a short time because on about his first job, I think it was a job with Buddy Petit

ctx.x: I wouldn't be surprised because they were very good friends.

Only a short time because on about his first job, I think it was a job with Buddy Petit, he said way up at Louisiana Avenue, so he was going to walk up there. He got up along where the pawn shops are on Ramport, took his drums in there and pawned them and went back home. Went back home. Didn't show up for the job. His father gave him a hard whipping that night and all and then later he went to Emmanuel Perez and took up the trumpet, the carnet. But that's the way he did on his first job, gave him up right there,…
Because that's where I can recall them very well.
